captain.lede.en: A ward captain gets people to stay for the count at the polling units in one ward. Read the captain's guide first.
captain.lede.ha: Kyaftin na unguwa yana sa mutane su tsaya domin ƙidaya a rukunan zaɓe na unguwa ɗaya. Karanta jagorar kyaftin tukuna.
captain.lede.ig: Onye ndú ward na-eme ka ndị mmadụ nọrọ maka ọgụgụ na ngalaba ntuli aka dị n'otu ward. Buru ụzọ gụọ ntuziaka onye ndú.
captain.lede.yo: Olùdarí àgọ́ ń jẹ́ kí àwọn ènìyàn dúró fún ìkà ní àwọn ẹ̀ka ìdìbò inú àgọ́ kan. Kọ́kọ́ ka ìtọ́sọ́nà olùdarí.

captain.organisation-hint.en: For example a residents' association, a youth group or a union branch.
captain.organisation-hint.ha: Misali ƙungiyar mazauna unguwa, ƙungiyar matasa ko reshen ƙungiyar ma'aikata.
captain.organisation-hint.ig: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, otu ndị bi n'obodo, otu ndị ntorobịa ma ọ bụ alaka otu ndị ọrụ.
captain.organisation-hint.yo: Fún àpẹẹrẹ ẹgbẹ́ olùgbé àdúgbò, ẹgbẹ́ ọ̀dọ́ tàbí ẹ̀ka ẹgbẹ́ òṣìṣẹ́.

captain.note.ha: Me ya sa kai, da duk wata ƙwarewa
captain.note.ig: Gịnị mere gị, na ahụmahụ ọ bụla
captain.note.yo: Kí ló dé tí ìwọ, àti ìrírí èyíkéyìí

captain.note-hint.en: A few lines: who you know in the ward, and anything you have organised before. Please leave out phone numbers.
captain.note-hint.ha: 'Yan layuka kaɗan: waɗanda ka sani a unguwar, da duk abin da ka taɓa shiryawa a baya. Don Allah kada ka rubuta lambobin waya.
captain.note-hint.ig: Ahịrị ole na ole: ndị ị ma na ward ahụ, na ihe ọ bụla ị haziri na mbụ. Biko etinyela nọmba ekwentị.
captain.note-hint.yo: Ìlà díẹ̀: àwọn tí o mọ̀ nínú àgọ́ náà, àti ohunkóhun tí o ti ṣètò rí. Jọ̀wọ́ má ṣe kọ nọ́mbà fóònù.

captain.volunteers.en: How many volunteers could you bring?
captain.volunteers.ha: Masu sa kai nawa za ka iya kawowa?
captain.volunteers.ig: Ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo ole ka ị nwere ike iweta?
captain.volunteers.yo: Àwọn olùyọ̀ǹda mélòó ni o lè mú wá?

captain.contact-h.yo: Bí a ó ṣe kàn sí ọ

captain.contact.en: We reply through Hawkeye alerts, never by phone call. Turn on notifications, or open @HawkEyeNGBot on Telegram and share your number there, so our reply reaches you.
captain.contact.ha: Muna amsawa ta sanarwar Hawkeye, ba ta kiran waya ba. Kunna sanarwa, ko ka buɗe @HawkEyeNGBot a Telegram ka raba lambarka a can, domin amsarmu ta iso gare ka.
captain.contact.ig: Anyị na-aza site na ọkwa Hawkeye, ọ bụghị site n'oku ekwentị. Gbanwuo ọkwa, ma ọ bụ mepee @HawkEyeNGBot na Telegram ma kesaa nọmba gị ebe ahụ, ka azịza anyị ruo gị aka.
captain.contact.yo: A máa ń fèsì nípasẹ̀ ìkìlọ̀ Hawkeye, kì í ṣe nípa pípe fóònù. Tan ìfitónilétí, tàbí ṣí @HawkEyeNGBot lórí Telegram kí o sì pín nọ́mbà rẹ níbẹ̀, kí èsì wa lè dé ọ̀dọ̀ rẹ.

captain.consent.en: Hawkeye may send me alerts about this application.
captain.consent.ha: Hawkeye na iya aiko mini da sanarwa game da wannan buƙata.
captain.consent.ig: Hawkeye nwere ike iziga m ọkwa gbasara arịrịọ a.
captain.consent.yo: Hawkeye lè fi ìkìlọ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí mi nípa ìbéèrè yìí.

captain.privacy.en: Only the Hawkeye team sees your application. It is deleted if you delete your account.
captain.privacy.ha: Ƙungiyar Hawkeye kaɗai ke ganin buƙatarka. Za a goge ta idan ka goge asusunka.
captain.privacy.ig: Naanị ndị otu Hawkeye na-ahụ arịrịọ gị. A na-ehichapụ ya ma ọ bụrụ na ihichapụ akaụntụ gị.
captain.privacy.yo: Ẹgbẹ́ Hawkeye nìkan ló ń rí ìbéèrè rẹ. A máa pa á rẹ́ tí o bá pa àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ rẹ́.

captain.no-access-note.en: Being a captain gives you no special access in the app. Hawkeye never shares who watches which polling unit.
captain.no-access-note.ha: Zama kyaftin ba ya ba ka wata dama ta musamman a manhajar. Hawkeye ba ya taɓa bayyana wanda ke lura da wane rukunin zaɓe.
captain.no-access-note.ig: Ịbụ onye ndú anaghị enye gị ohere pụrụ iche n'ime ngwa ahụ. Hawkeye anaghị ekpughe onye na-ekiri ngalaba ntuli aka ọ bụla.
captain.no-access-note.yo: Jíjẹ́ olùdarí kò fún ọ ní àǹfààní àkànṣe kankan nínú áàpù. Hawkeye kì í sọ ẹni tí ń wo ẹ̀ka ìdìbò wo.

captain.status-line.new.en: We have your application. Our reply will come as a Hawkeye alert.
captain.status-line.new.ha: Mun karɓi buƙatarka. Amsarmu za ta zo a matsayin sanarwar Hawkeye.
captain.status-line.new.ig: Anyị nwetara arịrịọ gị. Azịza anyị ga-abịa dị ka ọkwa Hawkeye.
captain.status-line.new.yo: A ti gba ìbéèrè rẹ. Èsì wa yóò dé gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìkìlọ̀ Hawkeye.

captain.status-line.contacted.en: We have sent you a message. Check your Hawkeye alerts.
captain.status-line.contacted.ha: Mun aiko maka da saƙo. Duba sanarwarka ta Hawkeye.
captain.status-line.contacted.ig: Anyị ezitela gị ozi. Lelee ọkwa Hawkeye gị.
captain.status-line.contacted.yo: A ti fi ọ̀rọ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí ọ. Ṣàyẹ̀wò àwọn ìkìlọ̀ Hawkeye rẹ.

captain.status-line.approved.en: You are the Hawkeye ward captain for this ward. Start with the captain’s guide.
captain.status-line.approved.ha: Kai ne kyaftin na Hawkeye na wannan unguwa. Fara da jagorar kyaftin.
captain.status-line.approved.ig: Ị bụ onye ndú Hawkeye maka ward a. Malite na ntuziaka onye ndú.
captain.status-line.approved.yo: Ìwọ ni olùdarí àgọ́ Hawkeye fún àgọ́ yìí. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìtọ́sọ́nà olùdarí.

captain.status-line.declined.en: This application was not taken forward. You can apply again, for this ward or another.
captain.status-line.declined.ha: Ba a ci gaba da wannan buƙata ba. Za ka iya sake nema, don wannan unguwa ko wata.
captain.status-line.declined.ig: Anaghị aga n'ihu na arịrịọ a. Ị nwere ike itinye ọzọ, maka ward a ma ọ bụ nke ọzọ.
captain.status-line.declined.yo: A kò tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú ìbéèrè yìí. O lè tún béèrè, fún àgọ́ yìí tàbí òmíràn.

captain.err.ward-required.en: Choose your state, local government and ward.
captain.err.ward-required.ha: Zaɓi jiharka, karamar hukumarka da unguwarka.
captain.err.ward-required.ig: Họrọ steeti gị, mpaghara ọchịchị obodo gị na ward gị.
captain.err.ward-required.yo: Yan ìpínlẹ̀ rẹ, agbègbè ìjọba àdúgbò rẹ àti àgọ́ rẹ.

captain.err.unknown-ward.en: That ward is not in the register. Choose it again from the lists.
captain.err.unknown-ward.ha: Wannan unguwa ba ta cikin rajista. Sake zaɓar ta daga jerin.
captain.err.unknown-ward.ig: Ward ahụ adịghị na ndekọ. Họrọ ya ọzọ site na ndepụta.
captain.err.unknown-ward.yo: Àgọ́ yẹn kò sí nínú àkọsílẹ̀. Tún yàn án láti inú àwọn àtòjọ.

captain.err.note-required.en: Tell us briefly why you, and any experience.
captain.err.note-required.ha: Faɗa mana a taƙaice me ya sa kai, da duk wata ƙwarewa.
captain.err.note-required.ig: Gwa anyị nkenke ihe mere gị, na ahụmahụ ọ bụla.
captain.err.note-required.yo: Sọ fún wa ní ṣókí ìdí tí ìwọ, àti ìrírí èyíkéyìí.

captain.err.bad-volunteers.en: Enter a number of volunteers from 0 to 500.
captain.err.bad-volunteers.ha: Shigar da adadin masu sa kai daga 0 zuwa 500.
captain.err.bad-volunteers.ig: Tinye ọnụọgụ ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo site na 0 ruo 500.
captain.err.bad-volunteers.yo: Tẹ iye àwọn olùyọ̀ǹda láti 0 sí 500.

captain.err.consent-required.en: Tick the box so we can send you alerts about this application.
captain.err.consent-required.ha: Yi alama a akwatin domin mu iya aiko maka da sanarwa game da wannan buƙata.
captain.err.consent-required.ig: Kaa igbe ahụ akara ka anyị nwee ike iziga gị ọkwa gbasara arịrịọ a.
captain.err.consent-required.yo: Fi àmì sí àpótí náà kí a lè fi ìkìlọ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí ọ nípa ìbéèrè yìí.

captain.err.already-applied.en: You already have an open application.
captain.err.already-applied.ha: Kana da buƙatar da ke buɗe tuni.
captain.err.already-applied.yo: O ti ní ìbéèrè kan tí ó ṣì ṣí sílẹ̀.

captain.err.rate-limited.en: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
captain.err.rate-limited.ha: Gwaje-gwaje sun yi yawa. Jira 'yan mintuna ka sake gwadawa.
captain.err.rate-limited.ig: Mgbalị karịrị akarị. Chere nkeji ole na ole, wee nwaa ọzọ.
captain.err.rate-limited.yo: Ìgbìyànjú ti pọ̀ jù. Dúró ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀ kí o tún gbìyànjú.

captain.err.signed-out.en: Your session has ended. Sign in again to apply.
captain.err.signed-out.ha: Zamanka ya ƙare. Sake shiga domin ka nema.
captain.err.signed-out.ig: Oge nbanye gị agwụla. Banye ọzọ ka itinye arịrịọ.
captain.err.signed-out.yo: Ìgbà ìwọlé rẹ ti parí. Tún wọlé láti béèrè.

captain.err.network.en: Could not reach Hawkeye. Check your connection and try again.
captain.err.network.ha: Ba a iya isa ga Hawkeye ba. Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka ka sake gwadawa.
captain.err.network.ig: Enweghị ike iru Hawkeye. Lelee njikọ gị wee nwaa ọzọ.
captain.err.network.yo: A kò lè dé ọ̀dọ̀ Hawkeye. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ìsopọ̀ rẹ kí o tún gbìyànjú.

captain.err.failed.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.
captain.err.failed.ha: Wani abu ya faru ba daidai ba. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa.
captain.err.failed.ig: Ihe adịghị mma mere. Biko nwaa ọzọ.
captain.err.failed.yo: Nǹkan kan ṣẹlẹ̀ tí kò tọ́. Jọ̀wọ́ tún gbìyànjú.

captain.err.register.en: Could not load the list of places. Check your connection and try again.
captain.err.register.ha: Ba a iya loda jerin wurare ba. Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka ka sake gwadawa.
captain.err.register.ig: Enweghị ike ibudata ndepụta ebe. Lelee njikọ gị wee nwaa ọzọ.
captain.err.register.yo: A kò lè gbé àtòjọ àwọn ibi wá. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ìsopọ̀ rẹ kí o tún gbìyànjú.

captain.sent.yo: A ti fi ìbéèrè ránṣẹ́. A dúpẹ́.

captain.admin.intro.en: People offering to recruit observers for one ward. Message them through Hawkeye alerts, then set the status. Approving gives them no access to anything: share a ward's uncovered units personally, never on a public page.
captain.admin.intro.ha: Mutanen da ke son ɗaukar masu lura don unguwa ɗaya. Aika musu saƙo ta sanarwar Hawkeye, sannan ka saita matsayi. Amincewa ba ta ba su damar ganin komai ba: raba rukunan zaɓen unguwa da ba a rufe ba da kanka, ba a shafin jama'a ba.
captain.admin.intro.ig: Ndị na-enye onwe ha ịchọta ndị na-ekiri ihe maka otu ward. Zitere ha ozi site na ọkwa Hawkeye, wee setịpụ ọnọdụ. Ịkwado anaghị enye ha ohere ịhụ ihe ọ bụla: kesaa ngalaba ntuli aka ward a na-ekpuchighị n'onwe gị, ọ bụghị n'ibe ọha.
captain.admin.intro.yo: Àwọn tí ń fẹ́ gba olùwòran fún àgọ́ kan. Fi ọ̀rọ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí wọn nípasẹ̀ ìkìlọ̀ Hawkeye, lẹ́yìn náà ṣètò ipò. Fífọwọ́sí kò fún wọn ní àǹfààní sí ohunkóhun: pín àwọn ẹ̀ka ìdìbò àgọ́ tí a kò tíì bò fún wọn fúnra rẹ, kì í ṣe lórí ojú-ìwé gbogbogbò.

captain.admin.load-error.ha: Ba a iya loda buƙatun ba ({error}).
captain.admin.load-error.yo: A kò lè gbé àwọn ìbéèrè wá ({error}).

captain.admin.none-with-status.yo: Kò sí ìbéèrè pẹ̀lú ipò yìí.

captain.admin.another-open.en: This person has another open application. Decline that one first.
captain.admin.another-open.ha: Wannan mutumin yana da wata buƙatar da ke buɗe. Ƙi waccan tukuna.
captain.admin.another-open.ig: Onye a nwere arịrịọ ọzọ mepere emepe. Buru ụzọ jụ nke ahụ.
captain.admin.another-open.yo: Ẹni yìí ní ìbéèrè míì tí ó ṣì ṣí sílẹ̀. Kọ́kọ́ kọ ìyẹn.

captain.admin.reach.ig: Enwere ike iru ya site na: {channels}
captain.admin.reach.yo: A lè dé ọ̀dọ̀ rẹ̀ nípasẹ̀: {channels}

captain.admin.message-label.en: Message, sent as a Hawkeye alert
captain.admin.message-label.ha: Saƙo, wanda za a aika a matsayin sanarwar Hawkeye
captain.admin.message-label.ig: Ozi, a ga-eziga ya dị ka ọkwa Hawkeye
captain.admin.message-label.yo: Ọ̀rọ̀, tí a ó fi ránṣẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìkìlọ̀ Hawkeye

captain.admin.sent.yo: A ti fi ránṣẹ́ sí àwọn ìkìlọ̀ wọn.

captain.admin.sent-telegram.en: Sent to their alerts and Telegram.
captain.admin.sent-telegram.ha: An aika zuwa sanarwarsu da Telegram.
captain.admin.sent-telegram.ig: Ezigara ya n'ọkwa ha na Telegram.
captain.admin.sent-telegram.yo: A ti fi ránṣẹ́ sí àwọn ìkìlọ̀ wọn àti Telegram.

captain.admin.too-soon.en: A message went a moment ago. Wait a minute before sending another.
captain.admin.too-soon.ha: An aika saƙo ɗan lokaci kaɗan da ya wuce. Jira minti ɗaya kafin ka aika wani.
captain.admin.too-soon.ig: Ozi gara obere oge gara aga. Chere otu nkeji tupu i ziga ọzọ.
captain.admin.too-soon.yo: Ọ̀rọ̀ kan lọ ní ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn. Dúró ìṣẹ́jú kan kí o tó fi òmíràn ránṣẹ́.

captain.admin.rate-limited.en: Too many messages. Wait a few minutes.
captain.admin.rate-limited.ha: Saƙonni sun yi yawa. Jira 'yan mintuna.
captain.admin.rate-limited.ig: Ozi karịrị akarị. Chere nkeji ole na ole.
captain.admin.rate-limited.yo: Ọ̀rọ̀ ti pọ̀ jù. Dúró ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀.

captain.admin.not-active.en: This account is no longer active.
captain.admin.not-active.ha: Wannan asusu ba ya aiki kuma.

captain.admin.save-error.ha: Ba a iya canza matsayin ba ({error}).
captain.admin.save-error.yo: A kò lè yí ipò náà padà ({error}).

captain-guide.lede.en: A ward captain makes sure someone stays for the count at every polling unit in one ward. You are a volunteer, and Hawkeye stays independent of every party.
captain-guide.lede.ha: Kyaftin na unguwa yana tabbatar da cewa wani ya tsaya domin ƙidaya a kowane rukunin zaɓe na unguwa ɗaya. Kai mai sa kai ne, kuma Hawkeye ba ya goyon bayan kowace jam'iyya.
captain-guide.lede.ig: Onye ndú ward na-ahụ na mmadụ na-anọ maka ọgụgụ na ngalaba ntuli aka ọ bụla dị n'otu ward. Ị bụ onye ọrụ afọ ofufo, Hawkeye anaghị adabere n'otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị ọ bụla.
captain-guide.lede.yo: Olùdarí àgọ́ ń rí i dájú pé ẹnìkan dúró fún ìkà ní gbogbo ẹ̀ka ìdìbò inú àgọ́ kan. Olùyọ̀ǹda ni ọ́, Hawkeye kò sì gbè sẹ́yìn ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú kankan.

captain-guide.what-h.ha: Abin da kyaftin na unguwa ke yi
captain-guide.what-h.yo: Ohun tí olùdarí àgọ́ ń ṣe

captain-guide.what-1.en: Fill the uncovered units in your ward. Once you are approved, the Hawkeye team tells you personally which units still need someone.
captain-guide.what-1.ha: Cike rukunan zaɓen da ba a rufe ba a unguwarka. Da zarar an amince da kai, ƙungiyar Hawkeye za ta faɗa maka da kanta waɗanne rukunan zaɓe ne har yanzu suke buƙatar wani.
captain-guide.what-1.ig: Mejupụta ngalaba ntuli aka a na-ekpuchighị na ward gị. Ozugbo akwadoro gị, ndị otu Hawkeye ga-agwa gị n'onwe ha ngalaba ndị ka chọrọ mmadụ.
captain-guide.what-1.yo: Kún àwọn ẹ̀ka ìdìbò tí a kò tíì bò nínú àgọ́ rẹ. Nígbà tí a bá ti fọwọ́ sí ọ, ẹgbẹ́ Hawkeye yóò sọ fún ọ fúnra wọn àwọn ẹ̀ka tí ó ṣì nílò ẹnìkan.

captain-guide.what-2.en: Get each volunteer through the practice run, then the National Practice Days on Saturday 12 December and Saturday 9 January.
captain-guide.what-2.ha: Ka tabbatar kowane mai sa kai ya yi gwajin atisaye, sannan Ranakun Atisaye na Ƙasa a ranar Asabar 12 ga Disamba da Asabar 9 ga Janairu.
captain-guide.what-2.ig: Mee ka onye ọrụ afọ ofufo ọ bụla mee ọsọ omume, wee sonye n'Ụbọchị Omume nke Mba na Satọdee 12 Disemba na Satọdee 9 Jenụwarị.
captain-guide.what-2.yo: Ran olùyọ̀ǹda kọ̀ọ̀kan lọ́wọ́ láti ṣe eré àdánwò, lẹ́yìn náà Ọjọ́ Àdánwò Orílẹ̀-èdè ní Ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta 12 Oṣù Ọ̀pẹ àti Ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta 9 Oṣù Ṣẹ́rẹ́.

captain-guide.what-3.en: In election week, send reminders: save your polling unit, charge your phone, and stay for the count.
captain-guide.what-3.ha: A makon zaɓe, aika da tunatarwa: ajiye rukunin zaɓenka, caji wayarka, kuma ka tsaya domin ƙidaya.
captain-guide.what-3.ig: N'izu ntuli aka, zipu ncheta: chekwaa ngalaba ntuli aka gị, chaja ekwentị gị, ma nọrọ maka ọgụgụ.
captain-guide.what-3.yo: Ní ọ̀sẹ̀ ìdìbò, fi ìránnilétí ránṣẹ́: fi ẹ̀ka ìdìbò rẹ pamọ́, gba agbára fóònù rẹ, kí o sì dúró fún ìkà.

captain-guide.what-4.en: On 16 January, vote, then stay for the count at your own polling unit and photograph the result when it is posted.
captain-guide.what-4.ha: A ranar 16 ga Janairu, ka jefa ƙuri'a, sannan ka tsaya domin ƙidaya a rukunin zaɓenka ka ɗauki hoton sakamako idan an liƙa shi.
captain-guide.what-4.ig: Na 16 Jenụwarị, tụọ vootu, wee nọrọ maka ọgụgụ na ngalaba ntuli aka gị ma see foto nsonaazụ mgbe e gosiri ya ọha.
captain-guide.what-4.yo: Ní 16 Oṣù Ṣẹ́rẹ́, dìbò, lẹ́yìn náà dúró fún ìkà ní ẹ̀ka ìdìbò tìrẹ kí o sì ya fọ́tò àbájáde nígbà tí wọ́n bá lẹ̀ ẹ́.

captain-guide.invite-h.yo: Bí o ṣe lè pe àwọn ènìyàn

captain-guide.invite-1.en: Your own invite link is in My Profile, under Invite. Share it on WhatsApp or by text. Each person who signs up with it shows on your profile.
captain-guide.invite-1.ha: Hanyar gayyatarka tana cikin Bayanaina, ƙarƙashin Gayyata. Raba ta a WhatsApp ko ta saƙon tes. Duk wanda ya yi rijista da ita zai bayyana a bayananka.
captain-guide.invite-1.ig: Njikọ ọkpụkpọ gị dị na Profaịlụ M, n'okpuru Kpọọ. Kesaa ya na WhatsApp ma ọ bụ site na ozi ederede. Onye ọ bụla debanyere aha site na ya na-egosi na profaịlụ gị.
captain-guide.invite-1.yo: Ìjápọ̀ ìpè tìrẹ wà ní Àkọọ́lẹ̀ Mi, lábẹ́ Pè. Pín in lórí WhatsApp tàbí nípasẹ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ ìfiránṣẹ́. Ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó forúkọ sílẹ̀ pẹ̀lú rẹ̀ yóò hàn lórí àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ.

captain-guide.invite-2.en: For groups and notice boards, share the Get Hawkeye page.
captain-guide.invite-2.ha: Don ƙungiyoyi da allon sanarwa, raba shafin Sami Hawkeye.
captain-guide.invite-2.ig: Maka otu na bọọdụ ọkwa, kesaa ibe Nweta Hawkeye.
captain-guide.invite-2.yo: Fún àwọn ẹgbẹ́ àti pátákó ìkéde, pín ojú-ìwé Gba Hawkeye.

captain-guide.invite-3.en: Each volunteer saves their own polling unit in the app. Never collect a list of who is going where.
captain-guide.invite-3.ha: Kowane mai sa kai yana ajiye rukunin zaɓensa da kansa a manhajar. Kada ka taɓa tattara jerin wanda zai je ina.
captain-guide.invite-3.ig: Onye ọrụ afọ ofufo ọ bụla na-echekwa ngalaba ntuli aka nke ya n'ime ngwa ahụ. Achịkọtala ndepụta onye na-aga ebe.
captain-guide.invite-3.yo: Olùyọ̀ǹda kọ̀ọ̀kan ń fi ẹ̀ka ìdìbò tirẹ̀ pamọ́ nínú áàpù fúnra rẹ̀. Má ṣe kó àtòjọ ẹni tí ń lọ sí ibo jọ.

captain-guide.rules-h.ha: Ka zama ba ruwanka da jam'iyya
captain-guide.rules-h.ig: Anọla n'akụkụ otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị ọ bụla
captain-guide.rules-h.yo: Má ṣe gbè sẹ́yìn ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú kankan

captain-guide.rules-1.en: Recruit anyone, from any party or none. Party agents are welcome on the same terms as everyone else.
captain-guide.rules-1.ha: Ka ɗauki kowa, daga kowace jam'iyya ko ba jam'iyya. Wakilan jam'iyya suna da maraba bisa sharuɗɗa iri ɗaya da kowa.
captain-guide.rules-1.ig: Nabata onye ọ bụla, site n'otu ọ bụla ma ọ bụ n'enweghị otu. A nabatara ndị nnọchite anya otu n'otu ụkpụrụ ahụ dị ka onye ọ bụla ọzọ.
captain-guide.rules-1.yo: Gba ẹnikẹ́ni, láti inú ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú èyíkéyìí tàbí láìsí ẹgbẹ́. A gba àwọn aṣojú ẹgbẹ́ lábẹ́ òfin kan náà bí gbogbo ènìyàn.

captain-guide.rules-2.en: No party names, logos, colours or slogans in anything you send about Hawkeye.
captain-guide.rules-2.ha: Kada a sa sunayen jam'iyya, tambari, launuka ko take a duk abin da ka aika game da Hawkeye.
captain-guide.rules-2.ig: Etinyela aha otu, akara ngosi, agba ma ọ bụ ụkpụrụ okwu n'ihe ọ bụla ị na-eziga gbasara Hawkeye.
captain-guide.rules-2.yo: Kò gbọdọ̀ sí orúkọ ẹgbẹ́, àmì, àwọ̀ tàbí àkọlé ẹgbẹ́ nínú ohunkóhun tí o fi ránṣẹ́ nípa Hawkeye.

captain-guide.rules-3.en: Say "record what is announced". Never promise to expose rigging, and never predict a winner.
captain-guide.rules-3.ha: Ka ce "a naɗi abin da aka sanar". Kada ka taɓa yin alƙawarin fallasa maguɗi, kuma kada ka yi hasashen wanda zai ci.
captain-guide.rules-3.ig: Kwuo "dekọọ ihe a mara ọkwa". Ekwela nkwa ikpughe aghụghọ ntuli aka, ma ebula amụma onye ga-emeri.
captain-guide.rules-3.yo: Sọ pé "ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ ohun tí wọ́n kéde". Má ṣe ṣèlérí láti tú màgòmágó síta, má sì ṣe sọ tẹ́lẹ̀ ẹni tí yóò borí.

captain-guide.rules-4.en: Hawkeye is not INEC and not a party. Say so first.
captain-guide.rules-4.ha: Hawkeye ba INEC ba ne, kuma ba jam'iyya ba ne. Ka faɗi haka tun farko.
captain-guide.rules-4.ig: Hawkeye abụghị INEC, abụghịkwa otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị. Buru ụzọ kwuo nke a.
captain-guide.rules-4.yo: Hawkeye kì í ṣe INEC, kì í sì í ṣe ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú. Kọ́kọ́ sọ bẹ́ẹ̀.

captain-guide.rules-5.en: Never offer money or gifts for joining or reporting.
captain-guide.rules-5.ha: Kada ka taɓa ba da kuɗi ko kyauta don shiga ko bayar da rahoto.
captain-guide.rules-5.ig: Enyela ego ma ọ bụ onyinye maka isonye ma ọ bụ ịkọ akụkọ.
captain-guide.rules-5.yo: Má ṣe fún ẹnikẹ́ni ní owó tàbí ẹ̀bùn fún dídarapọ̀ tàbí fífi ìròyìn ránṣẹ́.

captain-guide.safety-h.en: Stay safe and follow the law
captain-guide.safety-h.ha: Ka zauna lafiya kuma ka bi doka
captain-guide.safety-h.ig: Nọrọ na nchekwa ma soro iwu
captain-guide.safety-h.yo: Wà ní àìléwu kí o sì tẹ̀lé òfin

captain-guide.safety-1.en: No result is worth your life. If there is trouble, leave, and report it later from somewhere safe.
captain-guide.safety-1.ha: Babu sakamakon da ya fi ranka daraja. Idan an sami tashin hankali, ka bar wurin, ka kai rahoto daga baya daga wuri mai aminci.
captain-guide.safety-1.ig: Ọ dịghị nsonaazụ ọ bụla dị mkpa karịa ndụ gị. Ọ bụrụ na nsogbu dapụtara, pụọ, ma kọọ ya emesịa site n'ebe nchekwa.
captain-guide.safety-1.yo: Kò sí àbájáde kankan tí ó ṣe pàtàkì ju ẹ̀mí rẹ lọ. Tí wàhálà bá wà, kúrò níbẹ̀, kí o sì fi ìròyìn ránṣẹ́ lẹ́yìn náà láti ibi tí ó ní àbò.

captain-guide.safety-2.en: Never interfere with election officials, voters or materials. Follow officials' instructions.
captain-guide.safety-2.ha: Kada ka taɓa tsoma baki ga jami'an zaɓe, masu zaɓe ko kayan zaɓe. Ka bi umarnin jami'ai.
captain-guide.safety-2.ig: Etinyela aka n'ọrụ ndị ọrụ ntuli aka, ndị ntuli aka ma ọ bụ ngwa ntuli aka. Soro ntụziaka ndị ọrụ.
captain-guide.safety-2.yo: Má ṣe dí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìdìbò, àwọn olùdìbò tàbí àwọn ohun èlò ìdìbò lọ́wọ́. Tẹ̀lé ìtọ́ni àwọn òṣìṣẹ́.

captain-guide.safety-3.en: Follow the Electoral Act and INEC's rules. Photograph only what is posted or handed out.
captain-guide.safety-3.ha: Ka bi Dokar Zaɓe da ƙa'idojin INEC. Ka ɗauki hoton abin da aka liƙa ko aka raba kawai.
captain-guide.safety-3.ig: Soro Iwu Ntuli Aka na iwu INEC. See foto naanị ihe e gosiri ọha ma ọ bụ nke e nyere.
captain-guide.safety-3.yo: Tẹ̀lé Òfin Ìdìbò àti àwọn òfin INEC. Ya fọ́tò ohun tí wọ́n lẹ̀ ní gbangba tàbí tí wọ́n pín nìkan.

captain-guide.never-h.ha: Abin da Hawkeye ba ya taɓa yi
captain-guide.never-h.yo: Ohun tí Hawkeye kì í ṣe

captain-guide.never-1.en: It never shares who watches which polling unit — not with you, not with a party, not with anyone.
captain-guide.never-1.ha: Ba ya taɓa bayyana wanda ke lura da wane rukunin zaɓe — ba a gare ka ba, ba ga jam'iyya ba, ba ga kowa ba.
captain-guide.never-1.ig: Ọ naghị ekpughe onye na-ekiri ngalaba ntuli aka ọ bụla — ọ bụghị gị, ọ bụghị otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị, ọ bụghị onye ọ bụla.
captain-guide.never-1.yo: Kì í sọ ẹni tí ń wo ẹ̀ka ìdìbò wo — kì í ṣe fún ọ, kì í ṣe fún ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú, kì í ṣe fún ẹnikẹ́ni.

captain-guide.never-2.en: It never publishes coverage below local government level.
captain-guide.never-2.ha: Ba ya taɓa wallafa yawan rufewa ƙasa da matakin karamar hukuma.
captain-guide.never-2.ig: Ọ naghị ebipụta mkpuchi n'okpuru ọkwa mpaghara ọchịchị obodo.
captain-guide.never-2.yo: Kì í tẹ ìbòòrí jáde ní ìsàlẹ̀ ìpele agbègbè ìjọba àdúgbò.

captain-guide.never-3.en: Being a captain gives you no access to anyone's details in the app.
captain-guide.never-3.ha: Zama kyaftin ba ya ba ka damar ganin bayanan kowa a manhajar.
captain-guide.never-3.ig: Ịbụ onye ndú anaghị enye gị ohere ịhụ nkọwa onye ọ bụla n'ime ngwa ahụ.
captain-guide.never-3.yo: Jíjẹ́ olùdarí kò fún ọ ní àǹfààní sí ìsọfúnni ẹnikẹ́ni nínú áàpù.

captain-guide.apply.en: Apply to be a ward captain
captain-guide.apply.ig: Tinye arịrịọ ịbụ onye ndú ward

coverage.become-captain.en: Help fill your ward — become a ward captain
coverage.become-captain.ha: Taimaka a cike unguwarka — zama kyaftin na unguwa
coverage.become-captain.ig: Nyere aka mejupụta ward gị — bụrụ onye ndú ward
coverage.become-captain.yo: Ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti kún àgọ́ rẹ — di olùdarí àgọ́
